content.value: You have a composite in which the Nb-Ti filaments comprise 25% of the cross-section, the (15) copper matrix $7 5 \% ,$ and you use it to carry a current of 100 amps. If the resistivity of copper and Nb-Ti are $2 \times 1 0 ^ { - 8 }$ and $1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 6 }$ ohm-m respectively, at room temperature, and $4 \times 1 0 ^ { - 1 1 }$ and $8 \times 1 0 ^ { - 7 }$ at $9 . 1 \mathrm { K } .$ how much current will each phase carry at each of those temperatures?
